title: Brave web search 422 on long note queries (query length limit)
description: Brave web search returns HTTP 422 VALIDATION when q exceeds Brave's limits: max 50 WORDS (confirmed: 51 words -> 422, 50 -> 200) and max 400 characters. buildQuery() (note title + last 300 chars of body) routinely exceeds 50 words, so 'From the web' failed with 422 even after the Answers-endpoint fix (OnlyNotes-oc9). Fix: clamp query in BraveSearchService.search() to first 50 words then 400 chars.

title: Fix 'From the web' note context: Brave search + OpenAI synthesis
description:
The note-taking 'From the web' feature calls Brave's chat/completions (Answers) endpoint, which fails: model 'brave-default' is invalid (HTTP 422) AND the current Brave plan doesn't include the Answers option (HTTP 400 OPTION_NOT_IN_PLAN). Brave web search works on the current plan. Fix: split retrieval from synthesis — run Brave web search, then synthesize a concise answer + citations with a current OpenAI model (gpt-5.6-terra, replacing retired gpt-4o) via the existing chat/completions endpoint.

BLOCKING scope:
1. Add OpenAIService.synthesizeWebAnswer(query:results:) async throws -> WebAnswer. Use chat/completions (codebase convention, verified working with gpt-5.6-terra). Model string centralized as a constant. Ask for JSON: {answer: 2-4 concise sentences grounded ONLY in supplied results; citations: [result indices]}. Validate indices against Brave results; map to real URLs.
2. Rewire ContentView webFetch closure: brave key empty -> .disabled; openai key empty -> .failed('OpenAI API key not set'); run Brave search; empty -> .noResults; else synthesize -> .answer. Remove the Brave answer()/chat path from this flow.
3. Delete now-unused BraveSearchService.answer() (hits the dead endpoint).
4. Brave search: add extra_snippets=true, keep count=5.

Acceptance:
- With both keys set, 'From the web' shows a synthesized answer with citations mapping only to actual Brave result URLs.
- No note-context code calls /res/v1/chat/completions on Brave.
- Missing Brave key, missing OpenAI key, empty results, Brave HTTP errors, OpenAI HTTP/parse errors all give clear UI states.
- xcodebuild -scheme OnlyNotes -configuration Debug build passes.
notes: Model decision updated during implementation: user chose gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17 (cheaper: $0.75/$4.50 per 1M, supports json_object, pinned snapshot for stability) over gpt-5.6-terra. Code uses gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17 — this supersedes the gpt-5.6-terra reference in the original description.
close_reason: Fixed: Brave web search + OpenAI gpt-5.4-mini synthesis with validated citations. Build passes, Codex review clean.

title: Fix 'operation failed' on audio import for long files
description:
Importing audio files via the new note screen's top-right import button fails consistently with 'operation failed' for files longer than ~12 minutes.

ROOT CAUSE:
In WhisperTranscriptionService.exportChunk (lines 171-197), the chunk export uses AVAssetExportPresetPassthrough together with outputFileType = .wav. Passthrough preserves the source asset's format, so combining it with a forced WAV output fails for any compressed input (m4a, mp3, mp4, etc.). AVFoundation surfaces this as the generic 'operation failed' NSError. Files shorter than ~12m20s skip exportChunk entirely (splitAudio returns the source URL unchanged) and work fine — which is why this is import-specific and length-specific.

SECONDARY ISSUE:
ContentView.swift lines 96-97 (file picker) and 161-162 (drag/drop) swallow file-copy errors with try?, then call importAudio anyway. A failed temp copy turns into a downstream generic failure with no useful message.

FIX:
1. WhisperTranscriptionService.exportChunk: switch to AVAssetExportPresetAppleM4A with outputFileType = .m4a, and have splitAudio name chunk files .m4a. transcribeChunk already detects format from URL extension, so the m4a chunks will be uploaded as audio/m4a to Whisper.
2. ContentView: replace try? with do/try/catch around the temp copy; on failure, set appState.importError with a clear message and skip the import call. Apply to both picker and drag/drop paths.
3. Generate unique temp filenames (e.g. prefix with UUID) so re-imports of the same filename don't collide.
4. Optional: when throwing exportFailed, include exportSession.error.localizedDescription for better diagnostics.

ACCEPTANCE:
- Importing long .m4a, .mp3, and .wav files succeeds.
- Short imports still succeed.
- Build passes: xcodebuild -scheme OnlyNotes -configuration Debug build
- If file copy fails, alert says specifically that the copy failed (not generic 'operation failed').
close_reason: Fixed in 45af78e. Codex review passed (no BLOCKING). Follow-ups filed.

title: GPT-4o speaker consolidation post-pass for hybrid transcripts
description:
AssemblyAI over-fragments speaker labels in some recordings — single continuous sentences span 3-4 speaker IDs. Add a consolidation pass that asks GPT-4o to remap redundant speaker IDs without changing segmentation or text.

Design (per Codex):
- New OpenAIService.consolidateSpeakerTags(segments, apiKey) async returning new segments
- Only modifies speakerTag — preserves id, text, startTime, endTime, order
- LLM returns {remap: {old_id: new_id}} mapping; we apply conservatively
- Skip speakerTag == 0 (warning markers)
- Called AFTER mergeSpeakerLabels but BEFORE mic merge so speakerTag 1 stays reserved for mic
- Wired into all 3 hybrid entry points (stopAndProcess, importAudio, retranscribe)
- Fail-open: bad LLM response returns original segments unchanged

title: Slice OpenAI per-chunk text across AssemblyAI utterances for proper diarization
description:
gpt-4o-mini-transcribe returns one text blob per 12-min chunk (no per-segment timestamps). Current mergeSpeakerLabels assigns one speaker per chunk because each TranscriptSegment is 0.01s wide. Result: 12-min blocks all tagged with one speaker.

Fix:
1. Capture utterance text in AssemblyAI diarize (currently discarded)
2. New merge fn: group AssemblyAI utterances by which OpenAI chunk they fall in (by midpoint). For each chunk, slice OpenAI text proportional to each utterance's AssemblyAI character count, at word boundaries. Return one TranscriptSegment per utterance with OpenAI text + AssemblyAI speaker/time.
3. Remove inferSpeakers call after merge in hybrid path — AssemblyAI labels are authoritative
4. Apply to stopAndProcess, importAudio, retranscribe

Follow-ups (separate tasks): persist mic audio path for retranscribe, narrow dedupeOverlap to chunk-overlap window only.

title: Surface web context state always, separate disabled/failed/noResults
description:
Context panel hides all web-search states (disabled, error, no results) whenever internal note matches exist. User can't tell if Brave is failing, missing key, or just no matches.

Fix:
- Replace webAnswer+contextError with WebContextState enum: idle, disabled, loading, failed(msg), noResults, answer(WebAnswer)
- Render 'From the web' status row always, not gated on empty internal state
- BraveSearchService.search throws on empty key (not returns [])
- Distinguish noResults from error in fallback
- Preserve real failing-stage error (don't only surface answersError when search also fails)
- Trigger refreshContext on title changes too

title: Fix context panel: wire semantic note search + surface web errors
description:
Context panel only shows tag-matched internal notes, never semantic matches or web results.

Root causes:
1. refreshContext only calls findByTags, not findSimilar — semantic search exists but unused
2. BraveSearchService swallows all errors (timeout/auth/HTTP) and returns [] silently
3. contextError state exists but is never set

Fix:
- Add EmbeddingService.findSimilar call in parallel with tags + web
- Merge/dedupe internal results by note ID
- Surface Brave errors via contextError
- Increase Brave timeout from 3s to 10s
- Add error logging to BraveSearchService

title: Multilingual transcription + translate action
description: 1) Enable language_detection in AssemblyAI submit for multilingual/code-switching audio. 2) Add translate action to chat system: new targetLanguage field on MeetingAction, GPT-4o translates segments in batches, rewrites stored segments, regenerates summary.

title: Fix API compatibility for gpt-4o-mini-transcribe model
description: Switch response_format from verbose_json to json, remove timestamp_granularities param, add parser fallback for text-only responses (no segments key). Create synthetic segment from text field when segments absent.

title: Add error logging to transcription chunk pipeline
description: Replace silent try? with do/catch + logging in WhisperTranscriptionService.transcribe(systemURL:micURL:). Log HTTP status, x-request-id, and error body per chunk. Make parseWhisperResponse throw on unexpected JSON. Include collected errors in thrown WhisperError.

title: Narrow dedupeOverlap to actual chunk-overlap window
description: Current dedupeOverlap removes duplicate text globally. Short acknowledgments like 'yeah', 'right', 'okay' from different speakers get silently removed, damaging turn structure. Restrict dedup to the ~20s overlap window between adjacent chunks only.

title: Persist mic audio path for retranscribe
description: MeetingAttachment only stores systemAudioFilePath. Retranscribe drops the mic track entirely (passes micURL: nil), which loses the local-speaker-isolated track. Need MeetingAttachment.micAudioFilePath with backward-compat decoding.

title: Improve context query: extract topics instead of last 300 chars
description:
buildQuery currently uses title + last 300 body chars. Long notes with multiple topics produce a noisy mixed query that returns mediocre web results.

Proposed: use GPT to extract 1-3 key topics from the note body, search each. Or chunk by paragraph and pick the most distinctive.

Tradeoffs: more OpenAI cost + latency. Could throttle to once per N seconds.

title: Brave Search AI summaries instead of raw results
description:
Replace Brave web search with Brave Answers API (POST /res/v1/chat/completions) — the old summarizer is deprecated. Returns synthesized answer + citations instead of 5 blue links.

Changes:
1. New WebAnswer model: answerText + [Citation(title, url)]
2. BraveSearchService: new answerQuery method hitting Answers API
3. ContentView: replace webContextResults list with single answer card + citations
4. Insert logic: answer prose + citations block
5. Fix Task.detached for proper cancellation
6. Surface 402/403 errors (plan-gated endpoint)
7. Fallback to raw search if Answers fails

title: Click-to-insert context results with reference links
description:
When user clicks a context result (internal note or web), extract the relevant snippet and insert it into the note body with a reference link.

For internal notes: insert the snippet text + a markdown reference like [Source: Note Title]
For web results: insert the snippet text + a markdown link like [Source](url)

Replace the current browser-open behavior for web results. Add tap handler for internal note results (currently display-only).

Affected files:
- ContentView.swift — add tap handler to contextResultRow, insert text into note.body
- May need cursor position tracking or just append to end of body

title: GPT-4o speaker inference as post-processing pass
description: After hybrid transcription (AssemblyAI diarization + OpenAI text), run GPT-4o speaker inference as a second pass to correct/improve speaker labels using conversational patterns. The inferSpeakers method already exists in WhisperTranscriptionService but is only used in the single-file path. Wire it into the hybrid pipeline in AppState.stopAndProcess, MeetingActionExecutor retranscribe, and AppState.importAudio.

title: Hybrid transcription: AssemblyAI diarization + OpenAI transcription
description:
AssemblyAI handles multilingual audio poorly (merges languages) but does speaker diarization well. gpt-4o-mini-transcribe handles multilingual well but has no speaker detection.

Proposed hybrid pipeline:
1. Send system audio to AssemblyAI with speaker_labels — extract speaker-tagged time ranges (speaker A: 0-5s, speaker B: 5-12s, etc.) but discard the transcript text
2. Send same audio to gpt-4o-mini-transcribe for accurate multilingual transcription
3. Align: map AssemblyAI speaker labels onto OpenAI transcript segments by timestamp overlap

This replaces the current approach where AssemblyAI does both diarization AND transcription.

Affected files:
- AssemblyAITranscriptionService.swift — add method to extract diarization-only (speaker + timestamps, no text)
- WhisperTranscriptionService.swift — already does transcription, may need timestamp improvements
- AppState.swift — orchestrate hybrid pipeline in stopAndProcess
- MeetingActionExecutor.swift — same hybrid logic for retranscribe

Risks:
- Timestamp alignment between two providers may not be exact — need fuzzy matching with tolerance
- Doubles API cost (both providers called for system audio)
- AssemblyAI polling adds latency on top of OpenAI transcription — could run in parallel

title: Import audio file into plain note
description:
Add drag-and-drop + file picker to NoteEditorView so users can attach phone recordings.

Flow: drop/pick audio file -> copy to app storage (ImportedAudio/) -> Whisper transcribe -> GPT speaker inference -> summarize -> attach MeetingAttachment to existing note in-place.

Key: fix WhisperTranscriptionService content-type to detect file extension (m4a/mp3/wav) instead of hardcoding audio/wav. Pause autosave while importing. Keep existing note body/tags/title. Switch to MeetingDetailView on success via selectedNote refresh.

title: AI chat with full meeting control
description: Extend meeting chat so AI can take actions: retranscribe audio, regenerate summary, rename speakers, add/remove tags. Also add recovery UX for failed meetings.
close_reason: Implemented: chatWithMeetingControl, MeetingActionExecutor, updated MeetingChatView with recovery UX. Build passes.

title: AssemblyAI speaker diarization for system audio
description:
Replace WhisperTranscriptionService system-audio path with AssemblyAI Universal-3 Pro + Speaker Diarization add-on ($0.23/hr total, cheaper than Whisper alone at $0.36/hr).

System audio (remote participants) gets sent to AssemblyAI for acoustic diarization -> speakers tagged 2..N.
Mic track (local) stays as Whisper Speaker 1.
Merge by timestamp, same as current dual-track path.

New service: Services/AssemblyAIService.swift
New settings fields: assemblyAIApiKey in AppState + SettingsView.
Fallback to Whisper-only if AssemblyAI key missing or call fails.
Codex scoping done: /tmp/codex-diarization.md

title: Fix audio clipping regression
description: writeSampleBuffer in AudioRecorder.swift converts Float32->Int16 without peak normalization (removed when switching from mixing to per-stream writes). Re-add peak normalization: peak = max(abs(samples)), gain = min(0.9/peak, 4.0), clamp to [-1,1] before Int16 conversion. Sonnet fix already applied — needs Codex review + commit.

title: AI chat with full meeting control
description:
Extend MeetingDetailView chat to support AI-triggered actions via structured JSON output.

Actions: retranscribe (re-run Whisper), regenerate_summary (with optional user context), rename_speaker, add_tag, remove_tag.

New OpenAIService method: chatWithMeetingControl() -> ChatOrActionResult (mode: answer|action, assistantMessage, action: {type, args}).
New MeetingActionExecutor service validates and executes mutations.
Recovery UX: when segments.isEmpty && audioFilePath != nil, show chat chips 'Retranscribe this meeting'.
Separate isRunningAction state for long ops. Failure appended as chat message, not silent print.
Capture note ID before async actions to avoid stale overwrites.

title: Debounce title edits in note web-context (cost control)
description: ContentView.swift ~line 129 calls refreshContext immediately on every title change. Now that OpenAI synthesis (gpt-5.6-terra) is in the web-context path, rapid title edits cause redundant paid API calls. Add debounce comparable to the body-edit path. Follow-up from OnlyNotes-oc9.

title: UUID-prefix Whisper chunk filenames to prevent concurrent collisions
description:
WhisperTranscriptionService.splitAudio writes chunks to shared temp dir with deterministic names (chunk_0.m4a, chunk_720.m4a, …). Concurrent transcriptions (e.g. stopAndProcess + importAudio overlapping) could overwrite or delete each other's chunks.

Fix: prefix chunk filenames with a per-run UUID, e.g. tempDir.appendingPathComponent("\(runID)-chunk_\(Int(chunkStart)).m4a"). Generate runID at the start of splitAudio.

Flagged as NON-BLOCKING by Codex during review of OnlyNotes-mw1.

title: Batch consolidateSpeakerTags for long transcripts
description: consolidateSpeakerTags sends the full transcript to GPT-4o in one request. Long meetings (multi-hour) can exceed context limits and silently fall back to no consolidation. Split into batches (e.g. 100-utterance windows with overlap) and merge remaps across batches. Or pre-summarize speaker fingerprints first then make remap decisions on the summaries.

title: Better handling of diarization gaps in hybrid merge
description: When AssemblyAI returns no utterances for a chunk (rare), mergeSpeakerLabels emits the chunk text as a single segment with endTime = startTime + 0.01s, which produces malformed timing. Should ideally split the orphan text into sentence-sized segments and assign timestamps proportional to chunk duration.

title: Per-word timestamps for precise OpenAI text alignment
description: Current hybrid merge uses uniform-character-density heuristic to trim chunk overlap (~2.7% ratio). True alignment needs per-word timestamps, which gpt-4o-mini-transcribe doesn't provide. Options: switch to whisper-1 verbose_json (loses multilingual), or upgrade to gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize when available, or use AssemblyAI word-level timestamps to anchor OpenAI text more precisely.

title: Export audio file to user-chosen location
description:
Currently recorded audio is stored internally in ~/Library/Application Support/OnlyNotes/Recordings/. Users want to export/save a copy of the audio file to any location they choose (e.g. Desktop, shared drive) so they can share recordings with their team.

Proposed approach:
- Add an 'Export Audio' button in MeetingDetailView (near the existing audio player bar)
- Use NSSavePanel to let user pick destination filename and location
- Copy the audio file from internal storage to the chosen path
- Show success/error feedback

Affected files:
- MeetingDetailView.swift — add export audio button + NSSavePanel logic

Edge cases:
- Meeting has no audio file (imported note, failed recording) — hide/disable button
- File already exists at destination — NSSavePanel handles overwrite confirmation natively
- Large files — use FileManager.copyItem (not Data load) to avoid memory issues

title: Action chaining: compound chat requests
description:
Support compound chat requests like 'retranscribe and translate to English' by allowing the chat system to return multiple sequential actions.

Current limitation: chatWithMeetingControl returns a single MeetingAction per response. Users must send separate messages for multi-step workflows.

Proposed approach:
- Update system prompt to support returning an array of actions in sequence
- Change response parsing to handle both single action and action pipeline
- Update MeetingDetailView executor loop to run actions sequentially, feeding output of each step into the next
- Ensure partial failure handling: if step 2 fails, step 1 results are still saved

Affected files:
- OpenAIService.swift (prompt + response parsing)
- MeetingDetailView.swift (executor loop)
- MeetingActionExecutor.swift (may need pipeline-aware execution)

title: Per-note query cache for web context
description: Cache Brave+OpenAI web-context results keyed by normalized query string per note session so cursor moves / identical queries don't repeat paid calls. Follow-up from OnlyNotes-oc9.
